There is no separate nominal or tolerance column: each cell holds the product code, then the tolerance in brackets, then the spec code, and the nominal is the THCnn number in the product code. Spec codes are written 'QCSP001_XX-N_v.01', with no underscore after QCSP (the PDF writes 'QCSP_001_XX-N_v.01'). In every strain, grade I is the highest potency and the numerals descend from there. Rows marked '/' (no spec): KK, BB, COP, GOG, MRG, AA, CHA, HFG, SH, RS. Two rows are highlighted yellow and read 'da se izraboti, ima serija …' (Latin-script Macedonian, roughly 'to be drawn up, there is batch …'): SC (Strawberry Cough, SC062501) and CLE (Clemosa A Bud, CLE072501). Grades at ±10 % of nominal: MB, GP-I, BG, BSS-II, HPA-I/II, OPM-I/II/IV, WC-I/II, AB, JD-I, SCR-I/II, CC-I/II, ACC, J31-I/II, KC, PUM, WED and GRC-II.
